title: What if your cat was secretly the boss of the house?

bubbles.text: Order! This family meeting is now in session.
bubbles.name: Lady Mittens

beats.caption: item 1: breakfast is now at *4 AM*

bubbles.text: The bed is decor. The box is my office.
bubbles.name: Lady Mittens

beats.caption: item 3: your laptop is a *heated bed*

bubbles.name: Lady Mittens

stickers.text: Cats recognise YOUR voice... and ignore it 🐈 (2013 study)
stickers.title: REAL FACT

bubbles.text: All against? Five. All for? Me. Motion passes.
bubbles.name: Lady Mittens

bubbles.text: Next meeting: we annex the neighbours.
bubbles.name: Lady Mittens

Your cat calls a family meeting. Breakfast is now at 4 AM, the box stays, and the vote is 5 against 1... motion passes. 😼

What rule would YOUR cat add first? 👇
